title: Experts disagree on scope
context:
Chief architect: The two scope findings are complementary, not contradictory: one bounds the change in time (launch only, migration is #621) and the other bounds it by host (Claude Code only, other tools stay on npm). Both hold; the time-bound is the canonical scope statement because it is the gate the whole PR hangs on, and the host-bound is folded in as the second non-goal.

Target: scope
- product-owner: This issue only LAUNCHES the plugin for Claude Code; automatic migration of existing users is #621 and out of scope, gated on manual sign-off.
- product-owner: Codex, Gemini, Cursor and every other host keep using the npm package exactly as today; only Claude Code gains the plugin path.
